name: After recital C
title: REPORT on the European Central Bank – annual report 2025
part_text: Cd. whereas according to the ECB’s president, the ECB does not systematically perform monitoring of inflation data and price stability, which would give it intrinsic means to verify its success at achieving its own primary goal, but rather uses macroeconomic forecast models that have repeatedly resulted in excessive optimism, leading to expansionary monetary policy and subpar performance;
